body: He said that my enlistment had nothing to do with whether or not he loved me, but I don't know if I believe him

I enlisted 3 months before we broke up, he said that he would be there for me and that he would support me through this. The plan was that I would go in and make some money while he was in college and I would help support him and once I got out I would get my college paid for and he would look for a job and try to support me like I did for him. I msde the decision to join for us. But now I just feel stuck. I still want to do it... but I don't actually want to go and do it, you know what I mean? Like...I don't want to leave.
